paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: Paper constrains multiple DM models; dark photon absorption limits (panel F) reported as kinetic mixing kappa vs mass over 0.186-1 keV. Only one explicit numerical point available from Table I (m=0.5 keV, kappa=2.2e-16); rest is in plot (panel F, kappa ~1e-16 to 1e-14). Also constrains ALPs via g_ae (AxionElectron) with one point g_ae=7.7e-14 at 0.5 keV. DM density not explicitly stated; standard 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for bosonic DM absorption. CL=90%. | Vision: Calibration provided referred to panel A (SI DM-nucleus, sigma vs mass), but the DarkPhoton limit is in panel F with x-axis 0.2-5 keV/c2 (converted to eV: 200-5000 eV) and y-axis kinetic mixing kappa 1e-16 to ~5e-15. Table I gives a calibration point: kappa=2.2e-16 at m=0.5 keV (500 eV), consistent with the minimum of the curve near ~0.5-0.7 keV. The curve dips to a minimum near 700 eV then rises steeply toward high mass. Y-axis ticks read from right axis (1e-16, 1e-15, 1e-14). | Calibration: No calibration needed
